objective.text: Validate a locked framework upgrade with behavior regressions instead of treating dependency resolution as proof of application compatibility.

difficulty.rationale: Distinguish dependency compatibility constraints from the application behavior they cannot prove.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: Composer resolves and installs a new Laravel version successfully. Which evidence is still needed before concluding the application is compatible?

options.text: Relevant upgrade-guide review plus behavior regressions on the locked version and supported runtimes.
options.rationale: Dependency resolution establishes installable constraints; it does not prove application behavior across changed framework contracts.

options.text: The absence of changes in application source during the dependency update.
options.rationale: Unchanged caller code may still observe changed dependency behavior.
options.misconception: Unchanged caller code may still observe changed dependency behavior.

options.text: A second successful composer install with the same lock file, with no application tests.
options.rationale: Reproducing dependency installation is useful but still does not exercise application behavior.
options.misconception: Reproducing dependency installation is useful but still does not exercise application behavior.

options.text: A successful PHP syntax check of vendor files alone.
options.rationale: Syntax validity cannot detect behavioral changes in routing, validation or persistence.
options.misconception: Syntax validity cannot detect behavioral changes in routing, validation or persistence.
